Able to design evaluation metrics, analyze error cases, and improve performance through a combination of rules, models, and human review. Experience limited to using AI coding assistants alone does not meet this requirement.

  • Experience in fintech, trading platforms, or compliance-related businesses. Familiarity with multi-site SEO, configuration governance, and AI-assisted review or intelligent annotation systems is a plus.

  • Fluent in both Chinese and English, with the ability to communicate effectively in English in day-to-day business settings.

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet.

About the team

We build the infrastructure layer that routes AI inference at scale. Our platform serves billions of daily requests across 100+ large language models, handling model selection, provider failover, load balancing, and cost optimization through a single unified API. Thousands of developers and enterprises depend on it to operationalize LLMs across research, product, and production workloads.

The security surface spans API key and provider credential management across cloud boundaries, user prompt data flowing through the routing layer, a billing pipeline processing billions of daily events with financial-grade accuracy requirements, and an authentication layer federating external identity providers. You will lead and scale the security team that owns this surface. hands-on in the architecture and code, setting the technical direction, and directly elevating the security posture of the platform through your own work.

What you'll do

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You manage a fast growing team of software and security engineers and make outsized impact through technical depth. Your focus will be cloud security infrastructure and modern AI development practices.  This is a player/coach role: you’ll establish the roadmap and grow the team while continuing to design systems, write code, evaluate tools, and work through difficult technical problems. 

  • Own the security architecture. Threat-model the edge compute layer, provider integration surface, credential management system, billing pipeline, and analytics store. Make the architecture decisions — API key lifecycle, secrets rotation, data classification, auth enforcement — and partner with product and infra teams through implementation.
  • Secure the credential layer. Design and implement controls for API key issuance, rotation, revocation, and abuse detection across user-facing keys and upstream provider credentials spanning multiple secrets engines and cloud boundaries. This is the highest-risk surface on the platform and requires deep expertise in cryptographic credential management, OAuth/OIDC federation, and token-based access control.
  • Build detection and response. Instrument the platform for security events across edge, async processing, and database tiers. Build alerting, runbooks, and forensic tooling. Lead incident response when it matters. You own time-to-detect and time-to-contain, not just the playbook.
  • Integrate the platform into Stripe's security programs. Bring the platform into SecRev, vulnerability management, and incident response processes. Adapt controls designed for Stripe's primary infrastructure to fit an edge-first, multi-cloud architecture. Bridge Stripe's compliance frameworks (SOC 2, PCI DSS) with a platform that routes data across external providers.
  • Lead and develop the team. Manage existing team members and help rapidly scale it, in line with business and technical needs. Set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people. 

Who you are

You’re an engineer and a people leader who is comfortable representing the security posture to executive leadership. You enjoy building things yourself, but you also know how to create an environment where other strong engineers can do their best work. You’re resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity, and willing to start with a practical solution and improve it as you learn

Minimum requirements

  • Software & security engineering depth. 10+ years in software engineering with deep expertise in at least two of: API security architecture, credential and secrets management, cloud security (IAM, network segmentation, encryption), or application security for high-throughput distributed systems.
  • Hands-on technical leader. Strong software engineering skills and the ability to contribute directly to production code, infrastructure, and technical design. You have directly designed credential management systems, authentication architectures, or data protection controls for production systems at scale, not just reviewed others' work.
  • Multi-cloud and edge security. Experience securing workloads that span multiple cloud providers or edge compute platforms: secrets management across trust boundaries, data classification for data in transit, and compliance in environments where you do not control the full stack.
  • Team leadership. Experience managing and growing a team of engineers, setting high expectations, and developing people. You have led teams where the quality of the work depended on your technical judgment, not just your organizational skills.
  • Communication. You explain security risks, architecture decisions, and compliance tradeoffs clearly to engineering, product, and executive audiences.

Thrives with ambiguity. A resourceful, pragmatic approach to execution: you can prioritize under constraints, make clear build-versus-buy decisions, and deliver useful improvements without waiting for perfect information.

Preferred qualifications

  • The ability to secure high-throughput proxy, API gateway, or edge compute systems
  • Experience designing, operating, or security infrastructure on Google Cloud 
  • Deep knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and federated identity architectures
  • Familiarity with LLM inference infrastructure, token-based billing, or AI/ML platform security
  • Experience with laptop, device and endpoint security, including device management and secure access.
  • Background in payments, fintech, or regulated industries (SOC 2, PCI DSS, GDPR) with strict data-handling standards
  • Experience integrating a newly acquired platform into an existing security organization and compliance framework

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, and we're looking for someone who is excited to join the team.

In-office expectations

In-Office: Stripe is a "Live" culture. You will be expected to spend at least 50% of your time in your local hub to foster high-bandwidth, in-person collaboration.

Crypto.com is building the regulated home for prediction markets and derivatives in the United States. Through Crypto.com Derivatives North America and OG.com we operate a CFTC-designated contract market and a registered clearinghouse. OG.com Prediction Markets lists event contracts on sports, politics, economics, culture, and crypto, including single-event contracts and combos.

 

The problem you'll solve

  • It's Saturday night in the US. A partner broker messages: their customers' orders are stuck, and their support queue is filling up. You do not yet know if it is our gateway, their routing, the market data feed, or the settlement logic. People who can fix it are in the US, in Asia, or asleep. Today, whoever sees the message first owns it. That is the gap.

You do not write the fix. You decide who does, within minutes. You keep every affected partner current. You make the risk call on what happens in the next 20 minutes, the next 3 hours, and on Monday morning. Root cause is identified in the first 30 minutes. An issue does not sit open for four hours.
  • A platform failure usually hits many partners at once, not one. You run that room.
  • You report to the SVP of Product. You do not have a team on day one. Within 6 to 12 months, a person who is good at this builds the rotation and owns the partner relationships that come with it.
  • What you decide: severity, who gets paged, the live timeline, every partner update while the incident is open, and the recommendation to pause, halt, cancel, or keep trading. The on-call approver approves a pause or halt. Exchange Operations owns the listing and the settlement call. Engineering owns the code.

descriptions.job-16mur64:
Growth GTM Engineering sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, revenue generation, data, and automation, turning market intelligence and buyer insight into repeatable growth opportunities for Chainalysis.

Chainalysis is seeking a Growth GTM Engineer to build and scale the workflows, systems, and outbound strategies that help our Sales teams engage the right customers at the right time. This is not a traditional demand generation or marketing operations role. Growth GTM Engineers are hands on builders who own the full lifecycle of a growth play, from identifying an opportunity and developing a hypothesis through workflow creation, experimentation, and measurable commercial impact.

The role combines growth marketing, account based strategy, data enrichment, AI, and sales enablement. You will work directly with Sales to identify promising markets, uncover buying signals, map buying committees, and turn these insights into targeted outbound plays. Using Clay, AI, and connected data workflows, you will give sellers the context and tools they need to engage prospects more effectively.


Success requires strong marketing judgement, technical curiosity, hands on workflow building experience, and the ability to connect automation to real commercial outcomes.


In this role, you’ll:

  • Identify promising market segments, buying situations, and account level triggers in partnership with Sales.
  • Develop targeted outbound plays, defining the audience, buyer problem, messaging, offer, seller action, and success criteria.
  • Build, own, and optimise Clay tables and research workflows, connecting enrichment, signal detection, account research, and contact discovery.
  • Use AI to interpret market signals, classify accounts, and generate relevant research and messaging inputs.
  • Map key accounts and buying committees, providing sellers with clear, evidence based insights and recommended actions.
  • Work directly with Sales teams to test outbound plays, gather feedback, measure performance, and determine what to scale or refine.
  • Establish quality controls and source references to ensure research and AI generated outputs are accurate and trustworthy.
  • Turn successful experiments into reusable workflows, signals, audience logic, and play templates.
  • Connect outbound strategies with ABM, paid media, and lifecycle marketing initiatives.
  • Partner with RevOps on CRM integrations, sales tooling, tracking, and workflow governance.


We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Experience building B2B outbound, growth marketing, demand generation, or account based marketing programmes.
  • Strong marketing judgement across segmentation, buyer problems, positioning, and messaging.
  • Hands on experience with Clay or similar data enrichment and workflow automation platforms.
  • Practical experience using AI for research, classification, personalisation, and decision support.
  • A track record of working directly with Sales teams to turn growth ideas into executed outbound plays.
  • Experience identifying buying signals, researching accounts, and mapping buying committees.
  • The ability to distinguish verified evidence from assumptions and evaluate results critically.
  • A commercially minded approach, connecting growth activity to meetings, opportunities, and pipeline.


Required Skills:

Growth Marketing and GTM Strategy

  • Understanding of B2B go to market strategies, outbound motions, demand generation, and ABM.
  • Ability to identify high value segments and translate buyer insight into targeted growth plays.
  • Experience developing messaging and value propositions for specific audiences.

Technical and Automation Skills

  • Hands on experience with Clay or comparable enrichment and automation platforms.
  • Experience connecting data sources, research workflows, and automation tools.
  • Practical use of AI for research, personalisation, and interpreting information.
  • Ability to structure data, troubleshoot workflows, and maintain data quality.

Sales Partnership and Execution

  • Proven ability to work closely with Sales teams to develop and execute outbound strategies.
  • Ability to translate account insights into clear seller context and actionable recommendations.
  • Experience gathering feedback, improving adoption, and measuring commercial impact.


Day to Day Activities

  • Identify growth opportunities through market research, buyer signals, and Sales feedback.
  • Build and maintain Clay tables for account enrichment, contact discovery, research, and prioritisation.
  • Develop AI powered workflows that generate accurate account insights and seller context.
  • Create and launch targeted outbound plays with Sales teams.
  • Analyse performance across engagement, meetings, opportunities, and pipeline.
  • Refine, scale, or retire workflows based on results and seller feedback.
  • Develop reusable research components, signals, and play templates.
  • Work with RevOps on Salesforce integrations, tracking, and governance.
  • Document workflows and best practices to support adoption across teams and markets.


Personal Attributes

  • Builder mentality, enjoys getting hands on with tools, data, workflows, and automation.
  • Commercially minded, focused on generating meaningful sales conversations, opportunities, and pipeline.
  • Naturally curious about buyer behaviour, market dynamics, and emerging technologies.
  • Analytical and evidence driven, with strong attention to research quality and accuracy.
  • Experimentation focused, comfortable testing ideas and learning from results.
  • Collaborative and confident working directly with Sales and cross functional teams.
  • Self starter who takes ownership and thrives in a fast paced environment.
  • Excited by the potential of AI, automation, and connected data to transform go to market strategies.


Nice to have experience:

  • Experience with Salesforce, Marketo, Demandbase, Goldcast, or Qualified.
  • Familiarity with sales engagement platforms and outbound sequencing tools.
  • Experience with APIs, webhooks, SQL, or data integrations.
  • Experience connecting outbound, ABM, paid media, and lifecycle marketing programmes.
  • Familiarity with data governance and research quality controls.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.
